sub_problems.fills: The bus never bounces mail that a wired shim is still taking: no_receiver waits out a take under way before it judges the envelope undeliverable.
sub_problems.what: D1: no_receiver waits on the addressee's shim lock before it judges the envelope still waiting.
sub_problems.why: Measured 2026-11-16: two scratch buses bounced the first inspect ask to codemother with "codemother's shim could not take the envelope — it cannot wake a device to receive it", 0.24 s and 0.59 s after bus start, with her hooked and wired before and after. serve's backlog thread called no_receiver on
